gloss: non-life insurance, property and casualty insurance

definitions.gloss: non-life insurance, property and casualty insurance
definitions.explanation: Insurance that covers losses from accidents, natural disasters, theft, fire, and liability, as opposed to life insurance. Includes auto insurance, fire insurance, earthquake insurance, and liability insurance.

examples.japanese: {損害保険|そんがいほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}した→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I signed up for non-life insurance.

examples.english: Auto insurance is a type of non-life insurance.

notes:
Often abbreviated to {損保|そんぽ} in everyday use and company names (e.g., {損保|そんぽ}ジャパン). This is one of the two major categories of insurance in Japan, the other being ⟦{生命保険|せいめいほけん}→生命保険：18637_seimeihoken⟧ (life insurance, abbreviated {生保|せいほ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {損害保険|そんがいほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧: to sign up for non-life insurance
- {損害保険|そんがいほけん}{会社|がいしゃ}: non-life insurance company
- {損害保険|そんがいほけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧: insurance claim
- {損害保険|そんがいほけん}{料|りょう}: insurance premium

TYPES OF {損害保険|そんがいほけん}:
- ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}→自動車保険：26400_jidoushahoken⟧: auto insurance
- ⟦{火災|かさい}{保険|ほけん}→火災保険：20282_kasaihoken⟧: fire insurance
- ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: earthquake insurance
- ⟦{賠償|ばいしょう}→賠償：07641_baishou⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: liability insurance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生命保険|せいめいほけん}→生命保険：18637_seimeihoken⟧: life insurance — covers death, illness, and other personal risks
- {損保|そんぽ}: abbreviation of {損害保険|そんがいほけん}
